stemMd: A lever is balanced. A 20 N force acts 0.30 m from the pivot on one side. What force is needed 0.50 m from the pivot on the other side, with both forces perpendicular to the lever?
explanationMd: Balance requires equal opposing torques: 20 × 0.30 = F × 0.50. The first torque is 6 N m, so F = 12 N. A longer arm needs a smaller force for the same torque.

distractorRationale.c: Equal forces balance only with equal lever arms.
distractorRationale.b: This is the first torque numerically, not the balancing force.
distractorRationale.e: This uses an incorrect lever-arm relation.
